Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a safety-tier review. The change affects Bore toolpaths.

The shared ring plan keeps detection and generation consistent. The radial bands overlap at the floor. The final ring finishes the wall.
The blind-floor calculation uses the cutter flat. The plan checks the ring limit before allocation.

Local results against upstream/main `db091cb38163f3713ce44918ea973855cd0960ad`:
The PR already contains this main commit. The trial merge required no changes.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | PASS: 2 steps, 0 failed, 18.2 minutes |
| Motion: unit tests and 50 integration binaries | 780 passed, 0 failed, 46 ignored |
| App: unit tests and 46 integration binaries | 803 passed, 0 failed, 11 ignored |
| Bore motion pins | All 7 passed |
| App `bore_core` | All 5 passed |
| `cargo clippy -j 6 -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings` | PASS |

I repeated two mutations in the disposable local worktree:

1. I removed the ring budget check. `bore_ring_count_enforces_its_allocation_budget` failed: `Some(4097)` instead of `None`. It passed after restoration.
2. I restored the full cutter radius for a blind floor. `wide_bull_nose_bores_clear_the_floor_without_an_interior_ridge` failed. It measured a 1.9663289312132477 mm interior ridge. It passed after restoration.

All seven Bore motion pins passed again after restoration. The source diff is empty.

Requested changes: none.

No goldens moved. No UI files changed. The decision record explains the floor calculation, ring limit, and faceted STL fixture allowance.
No GitHub runner or physical machine cut ran. The ignored tests and release gate did not run.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
